# `aitbc network force-sync`

Force the local node to wipe and re-import its chain from a peer.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc network force-sync [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--peer-url` | text | — | yes | Peer base URL to import the chain from |
| `--admin-private-key` | text | — | yes | Bridge admin private key hex for the destructive-op signature |
| `--admin-address` | text | — | no | Admin address (defaults to address derived from --admin-private-key) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc network force-sync --peer-url <peer_url> --admin-private-key <admin_private_key>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc network force-sync --peer-url <peer_url> --admin-private-key <admin_private_key> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
